snippet.title: Ecclesiastes Lo-Fi 📖 Deep Scripture Meditation & Relaxing Bible Audio | Word-Fi
snippet.description:
Ecclesiastes Lo-Fi is an immersive 42-minute scripture meditation experience blending atmospheric boom bap textures, soulful instrumentals, and reflective Bible narration. Designed to slow the mind down and allow biblical wisdom to breathe, this Christian chillhop project provides a peaceful environment for deep thought, study, prayer, and sleep. 

Word Fi: Ecclesiastes is inspired by the timeless wisdom of scripture. Whether you are resting, driving, journaling, or searching for peace in a noisy world, let these ambient soundscapes guide your reflection.

This is not parody, mockery, or an attempt to diminish the Word of God. Word-Fi was created from a place of reverence, creativity, and deep respect for scripture. The goal is to create an atmosphere where biblical truths can be experienced in a calming and emotionally resonant way through music and sound.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TRACKLIST (Chapters)
00:00 — Ecclesiastes 1: Everything is Vapor
04:12 — Ecclesiastes 2: The Futility of Pleasure
08:37 — Ecclesiastes 3: A Time for Everything
13:24 — Ecclesiastes 4: Hard Work and Loneliness
17:40 — Ecclesiastes 5: Life Under the Sun
22:11 — Ecclesiastes 7: Wisdom for Living
26:53 — Ecclesiastes 8: Obeying the King
31:18 — Ecclesiastes 9: A Common Destiny
36:02 — Ecclesiastes 11: Invest in Life
39:44 — Ecclesiastes 12: Remember Your Creator
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCRIPTURE ACKNOWLEDGMENT
Scripture excerpts featured in this presentation are adapted from The Message translation by Eugene H. Peterson.
The Message © 1993, 1994, 1995, 1996, 2000, 2001, 2002 by Eugene H. Peterson.
Used in this project for reflective, artistic, and inspirational presentation purposes. All rights to the biblical translation remain with the respective copyright holders.

snippet.title: 7 Hours of Word-Fi: Psalms 📖 Lo-Fi Hip Hop for Prayer, Meditation & Deep Focus
snippet.description:
Hours of Word-Fi: Psalms 📖 Lo-Fi Hip Hop for Prayer, Meditation & Deep Focus

🙏 Welcome to Word-Fi: Psalms 🙏

This 8-hour lo-fi journey combines the sacred words of the Psalms with beautiful, soulful beats. Each track features a full chapter of the Holy Bible, sung to a lo-fi rhythm—creating the perfect atmosphere for prayer, meditation, deep study, or peaceful sleep.

Experience the Word in a brand new way.

⏳ Timestamps & Track list (The First Hour)
YouTube will automatically turn these into chapters on your video player:

0:00 — Psalm 19

4:12 — Psalm 37

9:11 — Psalm 34

12:40 — Psalm 42

16:05 — Psalm 46

19:15 — Psalm 78

25:10 — Psalm 90

28:24 — Psalm 104

33:15 — Psalm 139

37:22 — Psalm 119

44:41 — Psalm 19 (Loop 2)

48:53 — Psalm 37

53:52 — Psalm 34

57:21 — Psalm 42

1:00:46 — Psalm 46

✨ Highlights
📖 Scripture Meets Beats: Word-for-word Psalms sung over premium lo-fi.  Translated from the Message Bible

🎧 Deep Focus: Rhythms designed to help you stay in the flow.

😴 Ideal for Rest: A peaceful soundscape to help you decompress.

🕯️ Spiritual Atmosphere: Elevate your morning routine or reflection time.
